notes.title: v2.0.0 Update notification
notes.notes:
Dear lord

We expect to have a two-hour shutdown for update maintenance from 2:00-4:00 UTC on December 29, 2020. During the maintenance period, you will not be able to log in to the game. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

【Newly added and adjusted content】
Belle of War DLC is added, and you can also unlock the marriage, offspring, self-built female general and search and visit mission functions.
1. Marriage: through “monarch- bestow marriage” the king or the subordinates can get married with the opposite sex character. The couple in a marital relationship is less likely to be employed by the other states and there is chance to trigger the assist shooting.
2. Connection through marriage: through “diplomacy- connection through marriage” you can have marital relationship. After the successful marriage, the female side will join the male side and the covenant between two nations will last for 60 months.
3. Give birth and raise: only the monarch could have children. You can cultivate the offspring and the father and the teacher are important for the skill learning of the children. Heirs could even learn skills like Lianzhu or heart capture.
4. Self-built female generals: when you create the generals you can choose the gender of them.

5. Visit and search mission: you can send troops to carry out one-year-long visit and search mission. There is chance to meet the celebrities, explore the ancient tomb or experience special events. Attributes could be increased when meeting with celebrities, as high as 100. And tomb exploration may bring back with various items.

6. Added item: item “ Duke Lu’s secret note”, which can be used to replace 1000 gold during the research and development process. You can use only one of this for each time. It can also be obtained through market or the visit and search mission.
7. Added item: antiques, which can be used to improve the contribution when you go to the court. It can be obtained through market.
8. Added item: cyan shaft carriage, which can exempt gold for search and visit mission for once. It can be obtained through market or search and visit mission.

9. Added item: single shaft carriage. You can have as many as three heirs. If you find any of them is not talented enough you can send this one back to the hometown with carriages. And this won’t seize a seat of the offspring-_-|||. This item can be obtained through market.

10. Added item: leadership classics, force classics, intelligence classics, political classics and affinity classics. During the period of cultivating the heirs, you can improve the abilities of them with the help of the items above but within the limit. The classics can be obtained through market or visit and search mission.
11. Added item: rare secret book: leadership, rare secret book: force value, rare secret book: intelligence, rare secret book: politics, rare secret book: affinity. They can be used for generals with according attributes between 95 and 99 and improve their abilities with one point. They can be obtained through visit and search mission.
12. Added item: scroll fragment of war, scroll fragment of pugilistic, scroll fragment of music score, scroll fragment of scripts. Generals with serve skills can exchange them for rare secret book with celebrities during the visit and search mission. They can be obtained through market or visit and search mission.
13. Added item: tomb robbing charm, hair mound seal. They both could provide skill tomb robbing.
14. Added item: geography section, Yugong region map, water classics. They both could provide skill travelling.
15. Added item: cyan Inkstone, which could provide skill courtesy+appease+capable official. The treasure could only be obtained through tomb robbing.
16. Added item: the classic of mountains and rivers, which could provide skill ancient visit+ tomb robbing. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing.
17. Added item: Wei’s shooting method, which could provide skill assist shooting. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing.
18. Added item: Analects of Confucius, which could provide the skill appease. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing. 
19. Added item: Teaching of Mencius, which could provide skill effulgent. The treasure could be obtained only through tomb robbing.
20. Added item: travelling, which could improve the efficiency of visit and search and reduce four months(default value: six months) of the time for the search and visit mission. 
21. Added item: ancient visit, which reduce three months of the time for getting the report of search and visit mission. It could also cover the effect of travelling.
22. Added item: tomb robbing, which could help you search the treasure you found in the search and visit mission.
23. Added skill: serve, with which you can serve the celebrities in the search and visit mission and get reward.
Optimization and repair
1. Change the number of the generals you can send to the battlefield from 10 to 20.
2. Change the market and you can buy more stuff now.
3. Now the secret gift, fairy blossom and advanced skill treasure chest could provide orders and assist shooting skills probably.
4. Now you could have healing and generals skills during the research and development process.
5. We have adjusted the skills of Zhong Yao, Pei Xiu, Yin Mo and sun Xiu and made them have tomb robbing skill and search and visit skill.
6. We have adjusted the skills of Yang Song, Yang Bo, Huang Hao and Cen Hun and made them have serve skill. And the initial loyalty of Yang Bo has been lowered.(I bet you know what this means...)
7. We repaired the position errors in the battlefield.
8. We repaired the excessive amount of treatment with the use of healing skill.(thanks to 张琪Zhangqi again!)
9. We repaired the incorrect description of Reputation in the dictionary.(thanks to 一目四行Yimushihang again!)
10. We repaired the errors of spiritual mechanism skill of Wei Rui in the main script.(thans to 归来Guilai again!)
11. We repaired the errors of the prompt message appeared after the changing speed in the battlefield had been adjusted .(thanks to 大佬 Dalao!)
12. There have been several errors about the optimize records that cannot be saved.
(the errors that records that cannot be saved were caused by other system errors. We are trying to solve these problems, and because of the complexity of the problem, we need some time as we are actively following up with it.) 
13. We adjusted and optimized the text, interface and settings of the system and the skills of some certain items.
PS: the modifies towards generals data(attribute and skills) will be available after we release the next edition.
